text: In Switzerland, it is illegal to own just one guinea pig.
The reason? It might get lonely.
Since two thousand eight, Swiss law says social animals need a friend of their own kind.
You can love it and talk to it every day. Doesn't count.
But guinea pigs rarely pass away together. So when one goes, the owner is suddenly breaking the law.
Buy a young one, and the cycle never ends.
Enter Priska. A schoolteacher, who lives with eighty guinea pigs.
Your lonely pet gets a roommate. And when its time comes, the roommate goes home.
She even plays matchmaker. Sometimes a tired old grandpa gets a young friend, and feels young again.
A whole country made sure no guinea pig is ever alone.
Nobody wrote that law for people.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always there, so you're never the only one.
